tools.name: new_font
tools.scope: Only the default Latin Simple repertoire is qualified.

tools.name: save_font
tools.scope: Native in-place VFC/VFJ save with retained backups; existing files require overwrite=true. First native save requires original basename.vfc and creates a VFJ sidecar. Native Save As to another path is refused. UFO remains a limited single-master snapshot.

tools.name: close_font
tools.scope: Clean fonts only. Dirty fonts and save=true are refused without opening a dialog. No forced discard.

tools.name: get_features
tools.scope: Native source, shared FontGate classes and glyph order with revision. Not native compiled lookup access.

tools.name: set_features
tools.scope: Source replacement with FontTools validation, revision/dry-run and 1 MiB limit; include() refused. Raw layout bytes preserved. Native Undo and visual Lookup state not qualified.

tools.name: compile_features
tools.scope: FontTools feaLib detached compilation via MCP stdio, then raw GSUB/GPOS/GDEF publication with compensation and native package-library archive for persistence. 1 MiB compiled/8 MiB archive limits; additional generated tables refused. Native Undo, visual lookup behavior and fontpr compilation are not qualified.

tools.name: get_opentype_tables
tools.scope: Reads native runtime table bytes; helper-managed archives rehydrate after native save/reopen. Not fresh export/compilation. Inline data limited to 512 KiB; larger data requires file export.

tools.name: get_font_info
tools.scope: Returns 96 native FontInfo fields, not full VFJ package JSON; detail=full only. Master selection is supported.

tools.name: get_font_hinting
tools.purpose: Read master zones and standard stems.
tools.scope: Reads native PS/TT/family zones and PS/TT stems, per master with pagination. No automatic hinting.

tools.name: set_font_info
tools.scope: Native FontInfo field patches and masters[] are supported. scale_upm=true, axes/instances and arbitrary VFJ replacement are not qualified.

tools.name: list_glyphs
tools.purpose: List/filter glyph names and Unicode values.
tools.scope: Names/unicodes and query/has_unicode pagination only; facts/geometry filters are not ported.

tools.name: get_glyph
tools.scope: detail=construction only: layer flags and anchors; full VFJ/component detail and attachment analysis not ported.

tools.name: build_glyph
tools.purpose: Construct a glyph from a recipe.

tools.name: set_glyph_anchors
tools.scope: Native position/name/remove/expression/cloud fields; mark_enabled and native undo not qualified.

tools.name: get_layer_hints
tools.scope: Reads native stored PS hint position/width/orientation/name and TTH count. Ghost, lock/link decoding and include_tth command strings are not qualified; no hint detection.

tools.name: get_glyph_nodes
tools.scope: Indexed local nodes and transforms; extrema computation not ported.

tools.name: edit_glyph_nodes
tools.scope: Coordinate set/move only; preflight/dry-run supported, native undo not qualified. Components and Auto layers refused.

tools.name: get_glyph_metrics
tools.scope: Numeric width/LSB/RSB and current expression strings; empty glyph sidebearings are null.

tools.name: set_glyph_metrics
tools.scope: Manual numeric width/LSB/RSB. LSB shifts ink and advance together to retain RSB; explicit width/RSB conflicts rejected. Bound expressions and Auto layers refused.

tools.name: run_python
tools.scope: Persistent agent namespace inside FontLab 8; not the Scripting panel namespace. fontpr/mcp_tools expose only this ported subset.

tools.name: get_python_output
tools.scope: Only output captured from this adapter’s most recent run_python call, not the entire FontLab Output panel.

tools.name: export_font
tools.scope: FontLab 8 extension (not one of the native 9 catalog's 56 names): export using a native profile to a new directory. Interchange may omit FontLab-only data.

tools.name: get_glyph_info
tools.purpose: Read name, Unicode, spacing and glyph metadata.
tools.scope: read notes, color marks, tags and Unicode scalars for named glyphs.

tools.name: set_glyph_info
tools.purpose: Bulk-edit names, Unicode, notes, marks and tags.
tools.scope: preflight and apply bulk glyph metadata patches; native undo not qualified. Supports explicit new_name; does not rewrite feature/class text references or replace outlines.

tools.name: get_glyph_source
tools.purpose: Read all layer points/anchors as JSON or GLIF.
tools.scope: Read all existing layer points/anchors/width as native JSON or GLIF XML. Not a full FontLab document serializer.

tools.name: set_glyph_source
tools.purpose: Write point/anchor coordinates while preserving topology.
tools.scope: Write layer coordinates, width and anchors from JSON or GLIF; revision required. Existing shape/contour/node topology, types and smooth flags must remain unchanged; no native undo.

tools.name: get_font_structure
tools.purpose: Read axes, master locations and instances.
tools.scope: Read native axes, master locations and instance metadata with revision. Locations enumerate known axis short names only.

tools.name: set_font_structure
tools.purpose: Change axes, locations and instance metadata.
tools.scope: Patch/add axes and master locations; instances[] replaces the instance list. Revision/preflight/dry-run; native undo and rollback of axis insertion are not qualified.

tools.name: get_classes
tools.scope: Read native OpenType class memberships plus native panel summary; kerning class editing is excluded.

tools.name: set_classes
tools.scope: Patch/create/remove OpenType class memberships by name, with revision and dry-run. No native undo; nonzero class marks and kerning groups are refused.
